extensions.name: bugs-music
extensions.description: Bugs Music metadata provider with accurate track and album details, artist catalogs, TOP100, all genre charts from Bugs genre home, Music PD albums, and URL imports. Multi-source ISRC matching across Deezer, Spotify, MusicBrainz, iTunes and YouTube Music with hangul romanization fallback, 260+ artist aliases, iTunes hangul-latin bridging with English-registration feedback re-search, artist-name variant search, romaja-title queries and romaja fallback naming for romanized download sources, album-level lookup, variant-ISRC retry, and duration-verified scoring, Bugs CONNECT-badge cleanup, and variant-title demotion (instrumental/karaoke candidates lose to canonical ones). Hands confirmed Deezer/Spotify track identifiers (deezer_id/spotify_id) to the app's download resolver so downloads resolve directly instead of falling back to name search. Rate-limit pacing, transient-failure retry, and a 90s background requeue of blocked lookups keep 100-track batch matching from starving. Compound/collab-title registrations (the original title fully contained in the candidate title, e.g. "사랑은 봄비처럼... 이별은 겨울비처럼" or "... (Narr. ...)") are recognized as the same recording when artist match and duration verification pass as well. An off-by-default switch (DELIVER_APPLE_MUSIC_ID) can hand the Apple Music track identifier (apple_music_id) to the app's download resolver; the app does not accept the field yet (verified 2026-11-08), so the switch stays off. 2.2.8 moves translated-title alias queries ahead of the Spotify query budget (the 2.2.6 romaja budget fill was slicing them out) and adds the 영원은 그럴듯 ↔ Forever Has Always Been (Redoor) registration. 2.2.9 adds an iTunes KR storefront fallback: the KR search API returns zero results for entity=song queries (verified 2026-11-08/09), so a zero-result KR search is retried without the entity parameter and music-video records are filtered out; JP and US storefronts were verified healthy and keep the direct query. Adds title registrations 노스텔지아 ↔ Nostalgia (BIG Naughty, fixing a one-letter queue-name mismatch that kept the alias from firing while the KR search was down) and 첫 만남은 계획대로 되지 않아 ↔ Plot Twist (TWS international title, verified on JP and US storefronts).
